summary: useChatComposer (insertText, setDraft, chatAbout, clear, focus) now also fills the plain chat input; mentions arrive there as text.
howTo: Nothing to change. Without chatInteractions or completionProviders the chat input is a plain textarea; useChatComposer operations used to be ignored there and now apply: insertText appends, setDraft replaces, clear empties, focus focuses, and insertMention/chatAbout put the mention's visible text (for example @Bug 7 or /Open tasks) at the caret. openCompletion still does nothing in the plain input, which has no list.
